description: FDA device UDI lookup (GUDID) — Look up a medical device by its Unique Device Identifier in FDA GUDID via openFDA: di= device identifier, udi= full barcode text (GS1 (01)(17)(10)(21) parsed offline: lot, serial, expiry, check digit), or brand=/company=/model=/product_code=. Returns brand, company, model, class, product codes, 510(k)/PMA numbers, Rx/OTC, MRI safety, sterile, latex, storage and GUDID link. CC0. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_device_udi
